name: 文献工作台
description: 连接本机 Zotero 7(localhost 本地 API,零云依赖):浏览/检索文献库,一键生成每篇文献的阅读笔记,把 PDF 划线批注幂等导入笔记,并把规范引用块插进当前打开的笔记;PDF 阅读仍在 Zotero 里完成(zotero:// 协议唤起)。文献数据只在本机 Forsion ↔ Zotero 之间流动;仅「AI 读文献」会把该篇阅读笔记文本发给你登录的 Forsion 后端生成速览。
descriptionEn: Connects to Zotero 7 on this computer (localhost local API, no cloud dependency): browse and search your library, create a reading note for any item, import PDF highlights and annotations idempotently into that note, and insert a formatted citation block into the note you have open. PDF reading still happens inside Zotero (launched via the zotero:// protocol). Library data only ever moves between Forsion and Zotero on this machine; only "AI Digest" sends that reading note's text to the Forsion backend you are signed in to.

onboarding.intro: 文献工作台把本机 Zotero 文献库接进 Forsion:文献浏览检索 → 每文献阅读笔记 → 划线批注导入 → 引用块插入。PDF 阅读与划线仍在 Zotero 里完成,笔记与引用沉淀在这里。

steps.title: 开启 Zotero 本地 API
steps.description: 打开 Zotero 7 桌面端 → 设置 → 高级 → 勾选「允许本机其他应用与 Zotero 通信」(Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero)。默认端口 23119;改过端口的话到本插件设置里同步改。

steps.title: 开用
steps.description: 命令面板「文献工作台:打开」进入工作台:左栏选集合或检索,右栏点开文献 →「阅读笔记」建笔记、「导入划线批注」把 Zotero 里的高亮拉进笔记(重复导入只增量)、「插入引用」把引用块插进当前打开的笔记、「在 Zotero 打开 PDF」跳回 Zotero 阅读。写作途中用命令「文献工作台:插入引用(检索)」随手引用。

en.intro: Literature Workbench brings the Zotero library on this computer into Forsion: browse and search items → a reading note per item → import highlights and annotations → insert citation blocks. Reading and highlighting PDFs still happens in Zotero; the notes and citations live here.

steps.title: Turn on Zotero's local API
steps.description: Open the Zotero 7 desktop app → Settings → Advanced → tick "Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero". The default port is 23119; if you changed it, update the port in this plugin's settings too.

steps.title: Start using it
steps.description: Run "Literature Workbench: Open" from the command palette: pick a collection or search on the left, open an item on the right → "Create Reading Note" makes the note, "Import Highlights" pulls your Zotero highlights into it (re-importing only adds what's new), "Insert Citation" drops a citation block into the note you have open, and "Open PDF in Zotero" jumps back to Zotero to read. While writing, the command "Literature Workbench: Insert Citation (Search)" lets you cite without leaving the page.
